gorevler.tanim: AlphaFeedAdapter.parse_page: produce the https://www.alphafeed.example/items/<id> fallback URL for records whose sourceUrl is missing/null/empty but whose raw id is verified; reject the fallback for sanitized/hash-form ids
gorevler.kabul:
(1) fixture record 4 (id dddd1111-2222-3333-4444-555566667780, title 'Sample Item', no sourceUrl) new behaviour: disposition normalized, candidate not None, source_url 'https://www.alphafeed.example/items/dddd1111-2222-3333-4444-555566667780', canonical_url the same, item_key item_key_from_url(canonical_url), source_record_key 'alphafeed:dddd1111-2222-3333-4444-555566667780', dispositions ['normalized','filtered','normalized','normalized'], first==second replay
(2) the assertions of the record with a sourceUrl (the items[0] gammafeed publisher URL) are kept as they are
(3) sourceUrl null and sourceUrl '' + a valid id -> the same fallback as (1); in the tests the title matches the query title_terms
(4) no sourceUrl + a sanitized id (../../etc/passwd, token=abcdef123456) -> disposition rejected, candidate None, external_id starts with sha256-, no fallback URL
(4b) no sourceUrl + a ready hash-form id (^sha256-[0-9a-f]{64}$) -> disposition rejected, candidate None, no fallback URL
(5a) no sourceUrl + no id field at all -> disposition rejected
(5b) no sourceUrl + id True/False (bool) -> disposition rejected
(6) test_betafeed_stops_paginating_on_last_page and the other existing tests in the file do not change

assumptions.choice: while _identifier_was_sanitized is False, external_id is used directly as a URL segment
assumptions.reason: when safe_external_id does not change it, external_id == the normalized raw id; it contains no path traversal or credential residue

assumptions.choice: https://www.alphafeed.example/items/<id> is accepted by identify_item_url as dedupe_eligible and canonical
assumptions.reason: since the last segment of the path /items/<UUID> is a UUID it is not in _GENERIC_PATH_SEGMENTS; base_path_is_non_atomic=False, no query, nothing sensitive

assumptions.choice: the safe_external_id hash form ^sha256-[0-9a-f]{64}$ is fixed
assumptions.reason: _HASHED_EXTERNAL_ID_PATTERN defined in collectors.py is a fixed regex; an equivalent local constant is used in open_apis.py
